resources.string: Banking and payments, passwords and codes, incognito, the lock screen and SIOS are never saved. Choose other apps here.
Everything screen memory has saved is deleted, along with its keys. This can\'t be undone. It will keep remembering from now on.
It stops remembering and everything is deleted: what was saved, its keys and the image model.

Screen memory remembers what passes across your screen so you can find it later: that code, the address someone showed you, the blue sofa in a shop. It comes turned off and you decide whether you want it.
Only what\'s needed to find things, when the screen really changes.
The text you see on screen.
For images, any text in them and a fingerprint: 512 numbers to find them by what they show. Never the image or a description.
If you want, a small encrypted thumbnail of each moment. Off by default.
Some things are never remembered, not even encrypted.
Passwords, or the screen where you type them.
Banking, payment, password and authenticator apps.
The lock screen, or anything while the phone is locked.
None of this leaves your phone.
